displayText: The inside part is two x minus one, with derivative two. So f prime of x is four times two, e to the two x minus one, which is eight e to the two x minus one. At a half, the power is zero, and e to the zero is one, so f prime of a half is eight. If you got four, you dropped the factor of two from the inside.
